entities.summary: Martin Hamuljak (b. 1789-04-19, Oravská Jasenica) was a medical practitioner or physician of the Early Modern period, marked by exploration, reformation, and the rise of nation-states, active in Oravská Jasenica. Known in the fields of jurists & legal scholars.
